svg.text: The thumb travels between equal end insets.
Cap halves retain circular outer edges.
Fixed tone removes the unchecked shadow.
Pending keeps focus and blocks repeated changes.
Exploded spacing is schematic, not CSS z-index.
No built-in label; compose with a label slot.
Touch minimum and label gap: caller-defined.
All widths are geometric; no content widths.
